definitions.short: Noadjah , the name of an Israelite, and a false prophetess
definitions.full: H5129. Noadyah נוֺעַדְיָה proper name ( meeting with Yah ) — 1. masculine Levite, contemporary of Ezra Ezra 8:33 . 2. feminine a prophetess hostile to Nehemiah Neh 6:14 .
